comment: Plan ARIA-V3 §A0 + §2a — single source of truth for the L3 exclusion list (kernel-immutability + auth/tenant/migrations/infra/secrets/billing/production). Consumed by lane_classifier diff classifier (materialize-time) AND auto_merge.evaluate_auto_merge (merge-time). Adding/removing entries requires an ADR per Plan ARIA-V3 §B3.
_doc_note: Glob patterns use fnmatch semantics with '/' separators. The classifier resolves each candidate path via Path.resolve() (worktree-aware, follows symlinks) BEFORE matching to prevent path-evasion attacks (e.g. .worktrees/snowball/aria-kernel/foo would be normalized to /abs/aria-kernel/foo and matched). Adding a glob: (a) add it to l3_lane_exclusion_globs, (b) add the matching reason_code key, (c) update I-V3-29 parametrization. Removing a glob: requires ADR per Plan ARIA-V3 §B3 + SPEC §0.2 review.
